profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer @ Lattice | AI Developer Experience + Product Platform
profile.summary: Senior Staff Software Engineer with 10+ years spanning product and platform engineering. My current focus is AI developer experience and building agentic tooling that makes engineering teams more effective. I care about building systems that compound across teams without sacrificing safety or trust.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Own and evolve Lattice’s coding-agent platform, building interactive workflows and context-engineering patterns that improve agent reliability and developer experience
- Architected a data access layer across all products to enforce auditing and tenant isolation
- Developed the integration architecture to exchange Lattice data with external systems   
- Built reusable platform frameworks adopted by product teams to ship reliably and at scale   
- Shipped performance focused observability tooling, cutting time-to-triage for slow requests

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed an on-the-fly data aggregation engine in place of a full data warehouse, eliminating query timeouts for large customers and unlocking historical analytics
- Built and drove alignment on prioritization of sensitive data approval and external data onboarding workflows across product, design, and CX, unblocking a major HRIS platform launch

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: - Technical lead for a 0→1 people analytics product; consolidated fragmented data into unified dashboards and reporting

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Owned frontend modernization to Angular for Virginia Retirement System enterprise applications   
- Developed APIs supporting personalized retirement benefit calculations and planning experiences, helping participants understand and compare their retirement options

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Led development of online retirement workflows that replaced complex, paper-based applications for plan participants

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Skills: TypeScript · JavaScript · C# · Angular
